Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical factual error regarding the history of Texas. In Step 4, the Planner stated that "Austin became the capital of Texas in 1888 (the year the Texas State Capitol opened; Austin has been the state capital since)." This is incorrect. Austin was designated as the capital of the Republic of Texas in 1839 and remained the capital after Texas achieved statehood in 1845. The year 1888 refers to the completion of the current Texas State Capitol building, not the year the city became the capital. This error invalidates the final conclusion provided in the same step, which incorrectly cites 1888 as the relevant year for the Texas interpretation of the question.
